scope: Distinct coaching overlays for all current37 strategy-selector entries, with3 shared bases for unmapped selectors. Templates only; no feature implementation or opening recognition claim.
composition: Mapped selector = three patterns for its lesson display group plus its unique overlay. Unmapped selector = three joseki-core patterns plus its unique overlay. A selector is not itself a lesson display group.
globalGate: Use course context or validated game-history strategy recognition. A midgame SFEN alone cannot identify the opening. Metadata identifies the focus only; current facts establish every positional statement.
slotContract: Named slots must be provided by validated structured facts. Suppress a template if any required slot or trigger is absent. Candidate moves must be legal; geometric control and legal threats remain distinct.
